Metadata.title: MASC 2026 — SUPERNOVA
Metadata.description: Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026: SUPERNOVA — Vietnam’s arena for the next generation of marketing talent.

hero.eyebrow: Kotler Klub - VinUni House of Marketers
hero.description: Rebirth through innovation. Push past personal limits and leave a completely new legacy in marketing.

about.title: A new legacy starts with a collapse.
about.lead: MASC 2026 is an exclusive national competition hosted by Kotler Klub—the VinUni House of Marketers.
about.description: This year’s Supernova theme captures the moment talent is reborn: old limits give way, innovation erupts, and a stronger identity takes shape.
about.caption: Not a search for safe answers. A proving ground for marketers ready to build what comes next.

prizes.overline: For the teams that outshine the rest
prizes.title: Great work deserves a stellar reward.
prizes.poolDescription: Cash prizes, partner benefits, and opportunities designed to carry winning ideas beyond the competition.
prizes.grandDescription: For the team that turns a bold strategy into the year’s most convincing real-world campaign.
prizes.secondDescription: Recognizing sharp insight, ambitious creativity, and a pitch that keeps the pressure on until the final moment.
prizes.impactDescription: Celebrating the campaign that creates the strongest positive impact for its audience and community.

eligibility.title: Built for talent already in motion.
eligibility.description: Open to young people aged 18–22 who live and study in Vietnam, with the ambition to build a serious career in marketing.
eligibility.achieverDescription: You have earned high placements in case competitions and are ready to turn proven potential into a bigger result.
eligibility.leaderDescription: You hold an executive role in a university club and know how to move teams, ideas, and communities forward.
eligibility.marketerDescription: You have reached advanced rounds of Management Trainee programs or can demonstrate equal drive, discipline, and marketing focus.

journey.title: From first lightto full impact.
journey.description: Select a stage to reveal its challenge, stakes, and progression.

round05.title: The First Light
round05.summary: An open door for incomplete teams and industry newcomers.
round05.detail: Build your team, prove your potential, and compete for one of two direct passes to Round 2.

round1.title: The Star Gathering
round1.summary: Choose the field where your strongest marketing instincts live.
round1.detail: Teams enter Product & Growth, Societal & PR, or Market Research & Trade, with direct one-on-one feedback from industry mentors.

round2.title: The Stellar Forge
round2.summary: The top six teams take on the Diamond Sponsor’s challenge.
round2.detail: Solutions must balance breakthrough creativity, practical application, and meaningful positive impact for the community.

round3.title: The Cosmic Crash
round3.summary: Ideas leave the deck and enter the market.
round3.detail: The top four teams turn proposals into live media campaigns, gather real audience response, and prove what can work beyond the brief.

round4.title: Grand Finale
round4.summary: Networking Night, final campaign pitches, and one last live test.
round4.detail: After presenting their executed campaigns, the top two teams solve a surprise mini case on stage under time pressure.

criteria.title: What the judges will look for.
criteria.round1Description: Commit to one track and sharpen the work through direct mentor feedback.
criteria.round2Description: Balance breakthrough thinking with feasibility and positive community impact.
criteria.finaleDescription: Defend real campaign results, then solve an unseen mini case live on stage.

mentors.title: Guided by people who shape the market.
mentors.description: Meet the industry leaders bringing brand, research, and innovation expertise directly to this year’s competitors.

mentor1.name: Ms. Ngọc Nguyễn
mentor1.description1: Head of Brand Marketing Department at Canifa
mentor1.description2: Successfully led Canifa’s “Say It Now” and “Yêu Nước Từ Trong Nôi” campaigns, backed by over 15 years of experience
mentor1.description3: Judge for Z Marketer Season 5 and Hackathon Season 6

mentor2.name: Mr. Duy Nguyễn
mentor2.description1: Brand Business Development Manager at Nestlé

mentor4.name: Ms. Trang Hoàng
mentor4.description3: Mentor for the Unilever and Nestlé Vietnam Management Trainee programs

finalCta.title: Claim your placeamong the stars.
finalCta.description: Applications are open July 10–23 for ambitious marketing talent aged 18–22 living and studying in Vietnam.
